title: Cross-functional triage pattern for customer data governance requests (redaction, retention, PII, audit exports)
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Problem: Enterprise customers regularly request non-bug data governance controls (log redaction, retention window changes, PII masking, exportable audit packages). Requests arrive via support, account teams, and sales; response quality and SLA adherence vary. We need a repeatable triage pattern that routes, scores, and resolves requests with clear owners and minimal back-and-forth.
objective: Design and pilot a cross-functional intake + prioritization flow for non-bug data governance requests so that: 1) requests are scored consistently 2) routing to Eng/Legal/Security/Product is deterministic and automated where possible 3) SLAs and customer communications are clear 4) we capture minimal artifacts to reproduce and approve changes.
acceptance_criteria: Published intake form and scoring rubric in Confluence
Automated routing rules created in the intake tracker (Support -> PM/Legal/Eng as per rubric thresholds)
Owner assigned within SLA for >= 90% of pilot requests
Three pilot customer requests processed end-to-end with job notes, PR link, and closure template
Post-pilot retrospective with clear next steps and handoff to Docs/Support
steps: Draft intake questionnaire (required fields + optional context) with Support/AE templates
Create quantitative scoring rubric (customer risk, security sensitivity, regulatory requirement, engineering effort estimate)
Define routing matrix (score thresholds -> destination: PM/Legal/Eng/SRE/Privacy)
Implement intake form in shared tracker and wire up webhook to create Linear issues with prefilled metadata
Run 4-week pilot with 5 customers; collect metrics and feedback
Finalize runbook, SLA, customer-facing response templates, and training materials
notes: Scoring draft proposes weighting: Security impact 40%, Regulatory/Contractual 25%, Engineering effort 20%, Customer business impact 15%
Tradeoff: strict routing reduces late clarifications but increases false-positive escalations to Legal. Mitigation: quick 24h PM triage gate to reclassify
Consider templated mitigation options (temporary log filter, retention override with audit trail) to reduce engineering work
We should avoid requiring customers to share raw logs; prefer sanitized samples and reproducible repro steps
Retention changes should include expiration auto-reversion and audit trail by default
